title: QPACK RFC 9204 Foundation Work Item
summary: Promote the standalone QPACK implementation into canonical RFC 9204 specification, architecture, verification, and requirement-home trace artifacts without changing the existing module behavior.
planned_changes:
- Add `SPEC-QUIC-RFC9204.json` for the standalone QPACK module.
- Add canonical architecture, work-item, and verification artifacts for the QPACK foundation.
- Add requirement-home coverage for QPACK integers, literals, static table usage, field-section encoding and decoding, dynamic-table accounting, and instruction-stream parsing.
- Keep the module independent from `Incursa.Quic` while documenting the HTTP/3 integration boundary.
verification_plan: Run the focused QPACK milestone and instruction-stream tests, run the HTTP/3 QPACK error-handling matrix tests, validate the new SpecTrace JSON artifacts, and confirm that the requirement-home tests reference the new RFC 9204 specification and supporting artifacts.
out_of_scope: HTTP/3 request/response sequencing, settings, and header validation.
Runtime stream-state capture/restore behavior that goes beyond the standalone QPACK codec and table model.
completion_notes: The standalone QPACK module is already implemented; this work item closes the canonical SpecTrace ownership so the RFC 9204 floor can be audited and extended from a stable trace baseline.
